source.description: Approved eight-panel graphite and colored-pencil raster contact sheet.
source.notes: Private v1 and v2 sheets were rejected for state/count failures; approved v3 begins with true construction and preserves exactly five stones, two sticks, and three marshmallows.

process_strategy: A pale construction map grows through mug silhouette, fire-and-stone structure, sticks and marshmallows, detail, graphite, color, and only final reinforcement.

construction_contract.temporary_guides: Pale mug masses, handle gesture, flame triangle, five stone circles, two stick axes, three marshmallow boxes, highlight, and shadow map may soften later.
construction_contract.step_1_boundary: Only pale primitives; no closed mug, fire, stone, stick, or marshmallow contour and no value or color.
construction_contract.step_2_boundary: Only mug silhouette and handle become closed forms; fire, stones, sticks, and marshmallows remain guides.

final_elements.name: pale mug fire and marshmallow construction map
final_elements.description: Pale geometry establishes the mug, fire, five stones, two sticks, three marshmallows, highlight, and shadow.

final_elements.name: mug silhouette cream rim and right handle
final_elements.description: One broad enamel mug with a right C-handle appears behind the campfire.

final_elements.name: five stones and two-layer flame
final_elements.description: Exactly five rounded stones form the fire ring with one outer and one inner flame.

final_elements.name: two crossed sticks and three marshmallows
final_elements.description: Exactly two sticks cross above the fire and carry exactly three cube marshmallows.

final_elements.name: mug highlight stone facets and broken shadow
final_elements.description: One paper highlight, simple stone facets, and a short broken shadow complete the pencil drawing.

final_elements.name: graphite volume
final_elements.description: Directional graphite shades only established mug, fire, stones, sticks, marshmallows, and shadow.

final_elements.name: restrained navy coral gold brown cream and gray pencil
final_elements.description: Color fills only established forms while graphite tooth remains visible.

overlap_reservations.foreground_element: two crossed sticks and three marshmallows
overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The flame and stone facets stop beneath the two reserved stick routes and three marshmallow boxes.
